candidate.name: Workshop OS 12.3.9 Glance and Legibility
candidate.purpose: Touchscreen fixes from a UX critique of the 12.3.8 device captures, judged at arm's length. While a print runs, Home and Printer > Status show the percentage in a 48 px font with time left and the done-at time beside it, in one layout for both cards. The done-at time is fixed when the printer's estimate changes, so every screen shows the same time and it no longer ticks. Row values, stepper values, button labels and toasts are 14 px when they fit (10 px before), and the calm idle status line is 19 px. A not-set-up reason is grey instead of amber, an off switch keeps a visible outline, the smart-plug reason fits ('No smart plug') and temperatures say °C. Printer > Camera drops its control row: the picture runs from the header to the tab bar (a 16:9 frame at 394x222 instead of 314x177) and Pause/Resume is a header button. Re-test: scripts/accept_os12_retest_12_3_9.py.
